fullContentHtml:
HPSC Food Safety Officer (FSO) Online Form 2026 – Full Details

Haryana Public Service Commission (HPSC) has released the notification for the post of Food Safety Officer (FSO). This recruitment has been issued for 45 posts. The online application process for HPSC Food Safety Officer (FSO) Recruitment 2026 will start from 28 September 2026, and candidates can apply till 19 October 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for HPSC Food Safety Officer (FSO) Recruitment 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 19 September 2026
  • Application Start Date : 28 September 2026
  • Last Date : 19 October 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 19 October 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, General DESM -Male : Rs. 1000/-
  • OSC, DSC, BC-A NCL, BC-B (NCL), ESM, EWS : Rs.250/-
  • PwBD (with at least 40% disability): Rs. 00/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
